title: A zoomed recording's motion path shows where the camera points, or nothing
goal: When a recording is zoomed in and its framing is keyed, the canvas draws a dashed path for the move that follows the corner of the clip, a line across empty canvas that has nothing to do with where the camera is pointing. It should show the route of the centre, or not be drawn on a recording at all.
notes: Seen 2026-10-09 by a-recording-s-framing-reads-as-scale-then-centre. Repro: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk.json, pictures 3-framed-at-5-sc.png and 3b-centre-typed-sc.png show a dashed route from about (846,400) to (1465,633) screen points over the dark canvas, which is the posed origin path of the Position motion (copies under queue/audits/2026-10-09-zoom-centre-3-framed-at-5-sc.png). The video-zoom-wt mock draws no path in steps 6-8, only the frame ring. Which of the two (centre route or none) is a UX call; a decision card if unsure. Path drawing: grep motion path / route in Sources/Photonz canvas overlays; position on a takesAReframe layer is Layer.positionReadsAsCentre.
acceptance: With Scale and Centre keyed on a recording, the dashed path on the canvas either follows the point in the middle of the frame or is not drawn
A title or shape keyed on Position still draws its path exactly as today
A walk at Next defaults photographs the canvas with the zoom framed
